description: This file defines theme-related functions for a frontend project, including a base theme configuration and utilities for generating color palettes and mapping categories to colors. It exports functions to retrieve an ocean-themed color palette object, generate a categorical color palette, and create a category-to-color mapping, primarily used for styling visualizations.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens such as colors and typography hints.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Returns a deterministic palette of colors for categorical series, seeded by Ocean colors, accommodating up to a specified number of categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Maps a list of category names to colors using the categorical palette, maintaining a stable order.
